mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, EMAIL, NICKNAME AS DISPLAY_NAME, PASSWORD_HASH, MEMBER_STATUS FROM MEMBER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME, EMAIL, BIRTH_DATE, GENDER_CODE, PHONE_NUMBER, NICKNAME, PASSWORD_HASH, PRIVACY_CONSENT_YN, MEMBER_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{name}, #{email}, #{birth, jdbcType=DATE}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{nickname}, #{password}, #{privacy}, 'ACTIVE', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
